title: Senior Backend Engineer (Conversational AI)
description:
Company Description

Yuna's mission is to radically transform the way mental health support is accessed and delivered. By providing 24/7 instant and private support at the push of a button, we aim to address the significant gaps in mental health care accessibility. In a system where waiting times for therapists can reach up to 48 days and many people can't even afford care, Yuna is the answer to immediate mental health support needs.

Location: Remote (work from anywhere, with at least 6 hours overlap with PST)

What We Offer

  • Remote-first culture with flexibility

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.


Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.

Attitude:

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
AI Engineer – Data & Automation (Healthcare SaaS)


About Us

AMX Healthcare is building a new SaaS platform to transform how healthcare staffing is managed—connecting clients, contractors, and job opportunities with speed and compliance. We’re investing in AI to streamline recruiting, automate data flows, and surface insights from our knowledge base (resumes, job descriptions, Confluence, ATS/CRM, etc.).


Role Overview

We’re hiring an AI Engineer – Data & Automation to design and build intelligent systems that bring structure, insight, and automation to our staffing workflows. You’ll turn unstructured data (resumes, job descriptions, documents, chats) into actionable intelligence using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) , document intelligence , and structured extraction . This is a founding role to develop and own the AI function —defining architecture, best practices, and solutions that become foundational for our platform and business.


The Impact

  • Time-to-fill ↓ 30–50%: OCR → parse → validate → post cuts manual touches from hours to minutes.
  • Zero-drama compliance: Primary-source checks, expirations, and audit logs built in.
  • Revenue & margin ↑: Accurate pay-package math and cleaner timesheets reduce adjustments/write-offs.
  • Cash flow ↑: Invoice creation from approved time, automated AR, and payroll sync reduce DSO and billing errors.
  • Recruiter capacity ↑: AI SMS cadences and clean data flows speed shortlists and follow-through.
  • Decision speed: Live Sheets/Excel/Power BI replaces weekly spreadsheet marathons.
  • Platform rigor: MLOps, observability, and cost governance keep AI stable, safe, and affordable.


What You’ll Build

  • Document AI pipelines: OCR → classify → extract → validate → post for licenses, immunizations, I-9s, background checks, timesheets, and offers. Enforce strict JSON schemas, confidence scores, and text-span provenance.
  • Compliance automation: Primary-source license checks, date/format rules, name/DOB matching, immunization logic, and timesheet math (REG/OT).
  • Workflow integrations: Event-driven APIs/webhooks across Applicant Tracking Systems , healthcare compliance platforms , job boards , CRM/Marketing systems (e.g., HubSpot or Salesforce ), and Task Management Tools (e.g., Jira, Zoom Tasks).
  • Text message (SMS) automation: AI-assisted campaigns and cadences (opt-in, nurture, reactivation) triggered from ATS/CRM events; personalize copy, schedule sends, ingest replies/MMS docs, and auto-log to the system of record.
  • Comms → system of record: Integrate VoIP/SMS (e.g., RingCentral, TextUs, BeeTexting) with ATS/Compliance to auto-log activity, attach files, and trigger workflows.
  • Customer support & knowledge base automation: Zendesk + knowledge base workflows—AI triage/routing, macro suggestions, agent-assist via RAG with citations, chatbot deflection, and SLA dashboards.
  • Marketing & CMS automation: Content workflows with Jasper AI ; landing/job content in HubSpot CMS , Webflow , or WordPress .
  • Pay package automation: Bill rates + stipends + guaranteed hours → weekly packages with audit trails.
  • Finance, accounting & payroll automation (required): Integrations with QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools to:
  • Generate invoices from approved time, bill rates, and contract terms; handle credits/adjustments.
  • Sync AR/AP, post journal entries, reconcile payments; surface exceptions for review.
  • Automate payroll prep from timesheets and pay packages; route exceptions to HITL queues with full auditability.
  • Knowledge assistants: RAG chatbots over Confluence/SharePoint/Drive/ATS/CRM with permissions, citations, and human-in-the-loop review.
  • Live reporting: Streams to Google Sheets , Excel , and Power BI for exceptions, credential heatmaps, ready-to-work rosters, AR aging, and payroll variance.


MLOps & Platform

  • Dataset/prompt/embedding versioning; golden test sets; offline/online evals; A/B tests.
  • CI/CD for data and models; rollbacks; feature flags; latency/reliability SLOs; canary/blue-green.
  • Durable orchestration and state (idempotency, retries/backoff, dead-letter handling).
  • Observability (traces/metrics/cost), drift detection, PII/HIPAA redaction, RBAC, audit logs.
  • Cost governance: token/throughput controls, caching/TTL, embedding reuse, batching, FinOps reporting.


Must-Have

  • Strong software engineering in Python and/or C# .
  • Hands-on LLM/RAG (embeddings, retrieval, prompt design, evaluation).
  • Document ingestion at scale (PDF/HTML/images), schema’d extraction, validation.
  • Secure, auditable data design (HIPAA/PII ), APIs/webhooks, event-driven workflows.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems (ATS/Compliance/Job Boards/HubSpot /Salesforce ).
  • Experience integrating QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools for automated invoicing/payroll with audit trails.
  • MLOps fundamentals: data/model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, rollback.


Nice-to-Have

  • Healthcare staffing/credentialing domain.
  • Resume parsing APIs (Sovren, Textkernel, Affinda) or document intelligence services.
  • iPaaS/workflow tools (Zapier/Make), queues, human-in-the-loop review UIs.
  • Deploying AI apps on managed cloud (AKS/App Service or equivalents).
  • Information retrieval, knowledge graphs, or NLP research background.
  • Prior work on compliance-heavy systems (healthcare, finance, government).
  • Zendesk automation; Jasper AI content ops; CMS automation (HubSpot CMS, Webflow, WordPress).
  • Contributions to open-source AI/LLM frameworks or a strong portfolio of shipped AI projects.


Why AMX

  • Founding scope & ownership: Build the AI function—architecture, standards, roadmap.
  • Executive air cover: Direct line to the Head of Engineering; CEO-level sponsorship to ship.
  • Modern, open stack: Integrations across ATS, compliance, job boards, CRM/Marketing (HubSpot/Salesforce) , VoIP/SMS, CMS, accounting/payroll , and reporting—pick the best tool for the job.
  • Mission-critical outcomes: Help clinicians reach the bedside faster with fewer errors—visible impact on placements, revenue, compliance, cash conversion, and payroll accuracy.
  • Remote-first, pragmatic culture: Production over prototypes, HIPAA/PII first, human-in-the-loop where it matters.


EEO

AMX Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Soft Skills:

Expected Skills:

  • Lead and motivate teams, demonstrating empathy.

  • Evaluate and recommend technical solutions that align with business needs.
  • Establish and manage customer expectations.
  • Develop and execute a resource plan to ensure that the right people are in the right place, doing the right things at the right time.


Differentials (Nice to Have):

  • Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional) certification or equivalent. Scrum Master certification or equivalent Agile certification.
  • Education: Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Knowledge: Strong knowledge of ITIL practices. Knowledge of current and emerging technologies.

title: Executivo de vendas
description:
Sobre a Verzo:

A Verzo foi fundada em 2015 com o objetivo de auxiliar os hospitais e prestadores de serviço de saúde a aprimorarem seus resultados financeiros. Iniciamos movidos pelo propósito de ajudar a saúde do Brasil e animados com os desafios que o setor propicia.


Começamos como Aliança Hospitalar, prestando serviços de consultoria para hospitais. Logo nos apaixonamos por tecnologia e criamos o sistema VERZO. Com um time qualificado, o VERZO cresceu de forma exponencial e hoje atuamos com hospitais de todos os portes e perfis em todos os cantos do Brasil. Nos tornamos nativos de tecnologia e adotamos o nome VERZO para nossa companhia.


Durante a pandemia, percebemos o impacto causado não só nas instituições mas também nas pessoas. Decidimos lançar novas soluções de simples adesão, rápida implantação e que facilitassem a vida dos profissionais da área da saúde.


Hoje atendemos os hospitais e redes mais exigentes em termos de tecnologia e resultados. Estamos sempre inovando e criando novas soluções em parcerias com nossos clientes.


Viemos para ficar, valorizamos relações duradouras e a satisfação de nossos clientes é nosso principal objetivo.


O que fazemos:

Por meio de ciência de dados proprietária, nossas ferramentas trazem um ROI (retorno do investimento) claro e atrativo, além de apoiarmos as equipes na gestão financeira, cadastro, ciclo de receita, suprimentos e fiscal no atingimento de seus objetivos. Já foram identificados mais de  R$ 2 bilhões em oportunidades de aumento de lucro para +350 clientes no país.


Formamos parcerias com essas equipes que, com o uso de nossas ferramentas, entregam mais resultados para seus gestores como redução de glosas/bloqueios, aumento da rentabilidade de medicamentos e materiais médicos, tanto via redução de custos quanto aumento de receita e revisão de mix, e automatização de processos de controle da cadeia de fornecedores e fiscais. Além disso, otimizamos processos internos via tecnologia para liberar tempo da equipe para dedicar atenção e esforços ao que realmente gera valor.


Tudo que desenvolvemos foi com base no feedback das dores destas equipes em diversos hospitais Brasil afora. Conhecemos profundamente as necessidades do setor e sabemos como ajudar.


Prêmios e reconhecimentos: 

A Verzo é celebrada por sua excelência em inovação e qualidade de serviço. Fomos honrados com diversos reconhecimentos ao longo de nossa história como os destaques de “Tendência para a Saúde em 2024” pela Revista Medicina S/A em 2024, “Top Latin America HealthTech” pela HeathCare Tech Outlook em 2022, e selecionados pela Endeavor como uma das empresas de alto impacto no Brasil por meio do programa Scale Up Endeavor no mesmo ano.


Descrição da vaga e responsabilidades:

Estamos em busca de um Executivo de Vendas para integrar nossa equipe. As principais responsabilidades da posição incluem:

  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes.
  • Gerenciar funil de vendas de ponta a ponta: prospecção, qualificação, apresentações, propostas e fechamento.
  • Conduzir reuniões de demonstração do produto.
  • Negociar aspectos comerciais e garantir a melhor experiência do cliente durante o processo comercial.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Marketing e Customer Success para alinhar estratégias e melhorar a jornada do cliente.
  • Alimentar e organizar o CRM, garantindo previsibilidade de pipeline.
  • Atingir e superar metas de vendas


Local de trabalho: 

O trabalho será remoto, permitindo desempenho das funções de onde desejar. Por vezes, haverá necessidade de viagens para eventos e encontros presenciais com clientes.


Regime de contratação:

Contrato PJ


Requisitos mínimos:

Ao liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento de negócios, você desempenha um papel crucial no crescimento da Verzo e na melhoria contínua da saúde no Brasil. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para o sucesso dos hospitais parceiros, proporcionando resultados tangíveis e impactando positivamente a qualidade dos serviços de saúde oferecidos.

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B, preferencialmente em saúde, tecnologia e SaaS.

  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, consultiva e orientada a soluções.

  • Capacidade de lidar com diferentes perfis de clientes e influenciadores de decisão (C-level, gestores e técnicos).
  • Conhecimento em gestão de funil de vendas e ferramentas de CRM.
  • Disponibilidade para participação em eventos e encontros presenciais que envolvam viagens.
  • Imersão no entendimento dos produtos da Verzo e nas metodologias de vendas, com foco em SPICED, SPIN e CHALLENGER SALE.


O que valorizamos:

  • Experiência prévia no setor de saúde.

—


Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e explorar como podemos construir uma jornada de sucesso juntos.


Se você está em busca de uma oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa que valoriza a inovação e a excelência na saúde, a Verzo é o lugar ideal para você. Venha fazer parte do nosso time e contribuir com a vida!

description:
We are currently looking for researchers, retired researchers, and former researchers who can perform peer reviews for journals and publishers.

WHAT YOU NEED to Have

  • Doctorate PhD or equivalent advanced degree in the subject area

  • Published at least 12 papers in SCIE/SSCI/A&HCI journals in the past ten years

  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills
  • Strong written communication skills , with the ability to provide clear, concise, and constructive feedback

  • Familiarity with online manuscript submission and review systems

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Assess Novelty : Evaluate whether the manuscript is original and adds new knowledge or insights to the field of study.
  • Evaluate Study Design and Methodology : Check whether the study design and methods are appropriate, comprehensive, and clearly described to ensure reproducibility.
  • Literature Review : Ensure the manuscript thoroughly incorporates and cites relevant, up-to-date research in the field.
  • Analyse Results and Conclusions : Determine whether results are presented clearly and appropriately, and whether conclusions are supported by the data and significant to the field.
  • Provide Constructive Feedback : Suggest improvements and highlight any flaws, omissions, or ethical concerns.
  • Recommend Publication : Based on your evaluation, the journal editor will decide whether the manuscript should be accepted, revised, or rejected.

description:

Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa. Projeto: Futuro da Beleza - Vaga afirmativa é para talentos diversos — Pessoa com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras (pretas e pardas), Pessoas 45+, Comunidade LGBTQI+ e Mulheres (Cis e Trans)


Sobre a Oportunidade:

No Grupo Boticário, acreditamos que inovar é conectar hoje com o amanhã. O projeto tem como propósito apoiar a equipe de Inovação Estratégica de Produtos na estratégia do projeto Futuro da Beleza, identificando as rotas tecnológicas de produto mais promissoras para os próximos anos. Nosso objetivo é traduzir tendências em oportunidades concretas, transformando ciência e tecnologia em valor para milhões de consumidores.

Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de explorar territórios de inovação já mapeados, caracterizar e quantificar rotas tecnológicas a partir da análise de ICTs, empresas e startups, além de colaborar com áreas estratégicas como marketing, foresight, categoria (embalagem e formulação) e pesquisa.

O resultado esperado é a conexão entre a estratégia de inovação de curto prazo e as de médio e longo prazo, garantindo maior eficiência na identificação de oportunidades tecnológicas em PD&I. Se você tem perfil analítico, curiosidade para explorar novas fronteiras da ciência e vontade de gerar impacto real no futuro da beleza, que desejam cocriar conosco o amanhã da beleza.

Essa vaga afirmativa é para talentos diversos — Pessoa com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras (pretas e pardas), Pessoas 45+, Comunidade LGBTQI+ e Mulheres (Cis e Trans).


Formação Acadêmica: Mestre em Engenharia, Biotecnologia, Química, Farmácia, Analytics, Data Science, Estratégia ou Marketing.

Idioma: Inglês - Nível avançado (leitura).


Principais Atividades:

  • Realizar buscas em bases de dados já pré-definidas na metodologia, mapear e consolidar as tecnologias levantadas.
  • Fazer a análise crítica dos dados obtidos e cruzar com estratégia de inovação do Grupo Boticário.
  • Caracterizar as rotas tecnológicas identificadas de acordo com metodologia pré-definida.
  • Calibrar pesquisa com consumidores e realizar consolidação do material e análise crítica dos resultados.
  • Construir a apresentação do relatório final.


Conhecimento necessário:

  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar os dados obtidos e conectá-los com os relatórios estratégicos obtidos e liderados por outras áreas do Grupo Boticário;
  • Curiosidade e proatividade na busca por informações;

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

title: Global Feasibility Lead II
description:
Job Overview

The Global Feasibility Lead II will play an integral role in operational strategy and planning in the preaward space through participation in strategy development conversations, robust primary and secondary data collection and analysis, and development of feasibility and site selection strategies. In addition, the Global Feasibility Lead II will be responsible for managing global feasibility projects, working closely with representatives within the company to deliver robust feasibility reports to our customers. The Global Feasibility Lead II will transition the site selection strategy to operations in the post-award space by handing over relevant pre-award findings to the site selection team. The Global Feasibility Lead II will lead and/or contribute to process improvement and change initiatives within Feasibility, alongside training opportunities for departmental requirements and any other subjects that impact on feasibility conduct. The Global Feasibility Lead 2 role requires a diverse skill set; strong data mining and analytics skills, writing and presentation skills, and customer management skills are required. Comfort with participating in and/or leading client facing interactions as it relates to presenting feasibility related findings and recommendations is necessary.


Summary Of Responsibilities

  • Accountable for supporting the development, analyses, interpretation, and presentation of primary and secondary data in support of operational strategy and planning.
  • Conducts data mining of internal and external databases and initiates/oversees the collection of primary data for use in development of robust strategies for global clinical trials (country/site mix, site selection, enrollment modeling.).
  • Participates in the development of proposals and bid defenses; provides recommendations on the most appropriate use of data to support proposals and bid defense presentations, works with the team to identify potential risks, and is learning to propose effective solutions as appropriate.
  • Actively participates on cross-functional teams that plan, analyze, and present proposals and bid defenses as part of winning new business and maintaining client base.
  • Serves as functional bidder reviewer of the budget and text for proposals for which feasibility and/or site identification is included as the primary deliverable.
  • Leads cross functional teams in standalone feasibility efforts; responsible for final report creation and delivery, including discussion of findings and recommendations with external clients.
  • Participates in intra and inter-departmental meetings, leading/contributing to the presentation of information on feasibility offerings, demonstrating continued value-add of the department and providing training on best practices, processes and tools.
  • Develops networking abilities and has an ability/willingness to work with individuals across the globe.
  • Leads and/or contributes to process improvement or special projects within Feasibility.
  • Lead and/or contributes to development, implementation, and maintenance of systems within Feasibility.
  • Contributes to best practice for feasibility conduct.
  • Mentors junior team members (GFL1 or newer GFL2s as needed)
  • And all other duties as needed or assigned.


Qualifications (Minimum Required)

  • Associate degree with equivalent work experience.
  • Practical experience and understanding of global drug development and clinical trials including demonstrated experience for the mining, manipulating, and presenting of complex scientific data as it relates to clinical research and market analyses.


Experience (Minimum Required)

  • Candidates should have at least 4 years of working experience in an academic, science/health-related industry and at least 2 years of relevant experience in clinical research or a science/health-related industry. An associate degree is required; a master’s degree in a science-related discipline is preferred.
  • Position specific requirements:
  • Strong data mining and analytical skills.
  • Strong writing and presentation skills.
  • Upholds the highest standard of personal professionalism and work integrity.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently.
  • Strong attention to detail/quality control skills.
  • Ability to successfully and quickly understand scientific information so as to be able to independently source data/information relevant to a scientific/medical strategy.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with team members, management, operations staff, clients, and executive management.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities effectively.
  • Negotiation and relationship management skills.
  • Experience in analyzing study and investigator performance metrics.
  • Self-motivated, works effectively under pressure.
  • Technical Requirements:
  • Excellent computer skills, including strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and other data capture and compilation tools.
  • Established knowledge of tools used in obtaining critical market analyses of therapeutic pipelines.
  • Strong skills in scientific data manipulation, analysis, reporting, and maintenance.
  • Proven written and verbal communication skills, with strengths in independently gathering/presenting data in support of operational strategy and planning.

Learn more about our EEO & Accommodations request here.

title: Content Writer
description:
Job Description:

We are seeking highly analytical and detail-oriented professionals with hands-on experience in Red Teaming, Prompt Evaluation , and AI/LLM Quality Assurance . The ideal candidate will help us rigorously test and evaluate AI-generated content to identify vulnerabilities, assess risks, and ensure compliance with safety, ethical, and quality standards.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct Red Teaming exercises to identify adversarial, harmful, or unsafe outputs from large language models (LLMs).
  • Evaluate and stress-test AI prompts across multiple domains (e.g., finance, healthcare, security) to uncover potential failure modes.
  • Develop and apply test cases to assess accuracy, bias, toxicity, hallucinations , and misuse potential in AI-generated responses.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, safety researchers, and prompt engineers to report risks and suggest mitigations.
  • Perform manual QA and content validation across model versions, ensuring factual consistency, coherence, and guideline adherence.
  • Create evaluation frameworks and scoring rubrics for prompt performance and safety compliance.
  • Document findings, edge cases, and vulnerability reports with high clarity and structure.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience in AI red teaming , LLM safety testing, or adversarial prompt design.
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering , NLP tasks, and ethical considerations in generative AI.
  • Strong background in Quality Assurance , content review, or test case development for AI/ML systems.
  • Understanding of LLM behaviors, failure modes, and model evaluation metrics.
  • Excellent critical thinking, pattern recognition, and analytical writing skills.
  • Ability to work independently, follow detailed evaluation protocols, and meet tight deadlines.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work with teams like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, or other LLM safety initiatives.
  • Experience in risk assessment, red team security testing, or AI policy & governance.

Background in linguistics, psychology, or computational ethics is a plus.


Next Steps

To proceed further in the evaluation process, you will need to complete two assessments:

  • Assessment Test
  • Evaluates your linguistic and analytical skills
  • Link:



  • Versant English Proficiency Test
  • Focuses on assessing your spoken and written English proficiency
  • A C1 or C2 level is required to qualify


Once both assessments are successfully completed, you will be eligible for onboarding.

  • Language test

You will also receive an invitation to our internal job platform, XConnect . Please take a few minutes to register and complete your profile. All project onboarding, communication, and documentation are managed through this platform.

description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.

Data Cloud Consultant

Skills:

It is desirable that the candidate has a Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant certification, and should have experience in implementing and consulting on enterprise data platforms in a customer-facing role, including design, configuration, and solution architecture.


Recommendation:

Experience in implementing and working with strategy and data modeling, including building multiple solutions on Salesforce clouds.

- Have experience in development, strategy, business analysis, pre-sales solutions, or architecture.


Job Description:

Responsible for conducting customer discussions around requirements and technical drawing.

Development of software programs by technical specifications following programming standards and procedures, performing unit tests, performing program modifications and responding to problems by diagnosing and correcting logic and coding errors.

Ensure that secure coding and UI standards and best practices are applied during development.

Provide inputs and contribute to the improvement and maintenance of applications and programs.

Leading efforts to configure, analyze, design, develop, and maintain program code and applications.

Execution of detailed and complex unit tests and secure code testing and troubleshooting.

Conducting and supporting the source code management process.

Contributing to integration, systems and performance testing and code tuning.

Participation in secure code peer reviews.

Definition and promotion of opportunities for the reuse of code, configurations, procedures and techniques.


Requirements:

Degrees in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field are preferred.

Fluency in English to conduct technical meetings with offshore team, support teams and customers outside Brazil.

Experience with Data Architecture

Experience in writing SQL queries and data modeling, as well as governance and architecture performance practice and guidelines

Proficient in migrating data from traditional applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader utility

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

Solution Modeling - Creates, designs, and formulates models, diagrams, and documentation using IT processes, standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Data Modeling - Creates, writes, and tests data models, test scripts, and build scripts using IT processes, patterns, and tools, version control, and automation

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item or solution change using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including SDLC standards, tools, and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and providing customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity – Understanding complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

Global perspective – Take a broad view when addressing issues, using a global lens.

Action-oriented – Taking on new opportunities and difficult challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Optimizes work processes – Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.


Skills:

Knowledge of service-oriented design (SOA) principles.

Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.

Good interpersonal skills.

Extensive knowledge of Salesforce technology and specifically the data cloud and its features and terminologies;

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Salesforce Data Cloud certifications will be a plus for this role.

Proven experience in implementation and consulting of Salesforce Data Cloud environments.

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint

title: Senior Flutter Developer
description:
Senior Flutter Developer

Location: Remote

Contract: PJ (full-time)

Level: Senior


We’re building a virtual office platform for remote and hybrid teams. It brings together persistent rooms , real-time presence , audio/video (WebRTC) , chat , screen sharing , collaborative boards , and immersive spaces to boost connection, productivity, and team cohesion — all in one place.


The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Flutter Developer focused on macOS Desktop to build and evolve our desktop client. You’ll ship a high-performance, stable, and well-instrumented app that integrates video/audio, real-time features, and collaborative tools—while keeping top-tier code quality, testing, and documentation.

Secondary scope: help maintain Android and iOS builds (feature parity, fixes, and releases).


What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain the Flutter macOS app with clean architecture, modular layers, and reliable state management .
  • Integrate RESTful APIs and real-time services (e.g., WebSockets/Streams ).
  • Implement A/V features (e.g., flutter_webrtc): device selection, camera/mic permissions, I/O routing, and stability under variable networks.
  • Ensure observability end to end: instrument product events/metrics; triage errors with Sentry ; capture UX signals with Microsoft Clarity (session replay/heatmaps) where applicable (web/embedded views); analyze performance traces and dashboards.
  • Own quality : unit, widget, and integration tests; CI checks; code reviews; technical docs.
  • Handle macOS distribution : code signing & notarization , entitlements, Hardened Runtime , App Sandbox , Keychain; package DMG/PKG ; manage auto-update (e.g., Sparkle).
  • Collaborate with Product/Design/QA to refine requirements, edge cases, and acceptance criteria; keep specs tidy in Confluence and PRs clear.
  • Team rituals & reporting:
  • Attend daily standups in English and other ceremonies (planning, grooming, demos, retros).
  • Keep Jira up to date (status, links, attachments) and log time entries (work logs) per task.
  • Submit an end-of-day (EOD) daily report in English including: hours worked (per task), what was completed, current task & ETA, blockers, and plan for tomorrow.
  • Secondary (Android & iOS): maintain parity when applicable, fix platform-specific issues, help with CI/CD and store releases , monitor crashes/perf via Sentry and review UX insights with Clarity when relevant.


CPU & GPU Optimizations (primary focus)

CPU

  • Minimize rebuilds: effective state selection (BLoC/Riverpod/Provider), const constructors, proper Keys , split large widgets.
  • Cut redundant layout/work: avoid heavy logic in build, cache computed values, reduce intrinsic measurements, coalesce events, debounce/throttle streams.
  • Move heavy tasks off the UI thread: isolates (compute/custom), lazy JSON parsing, incremental work units.
  • Frame scheduling discipline: prevent setState loops; render only when state actually changes.

GPU

  • Reduce overdraw/repaints : place RepaintBoundary wisely; optimize CustomPainter (shouldRepaint); avoid large Opacity on complex subtrees.
  • Avoid expensive effects: minimize saveLayer , heavy blurs/gradients and big shadows .
  • Use right-sized images & filterQuality (low/none when acceptable); limit transforms on large layers.
  • Shader jank control: warm up shaders / capture SkSL where applicable; keep fragment shaders simple.
  • Pause/disable animations when off-screen; keep animation count/area minimal.


Measurement & Guardrails:

  • Profile with Flutter DevTools (CPU/GPU/frame timeline) and add perf budgets (avg CPU%/GPU frame time) to CI gates.
  • Track before/after metrics per feature; regressions must be fixed before release.


Must-Haves

  • Fluent English (spoken and written): comfortable in daily English standups and writing EOD reports.
  • Strong experience with Flutter and Dart building Desktop apps (preferably macOS ).
  • Proven work reducing CPU/GPU usage in Flutter apps (ideally desktop/macOS) with measurable before/after results.
  • Solid grasp of architectural patterns (MVC/MVVM/Clean ), DI , and state management (BLoC/Riverpod/Provider).
  • Hands-on with RESTful APIs , WebSockets/Streams , async/isolates , and robust error handling.
  • Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Analytics) or equivalent , Microsoft Clarity (for UX/session insights in web-embedded contexts), and Sentry for error/performance monitoring.
  • Git proficiency, code reviews, CI (e.g., GitHub Actions/GitLab CI ), and Jira work logs/time tracking .


Nice to Have

  • Deep macOS expertise: signing, notarization , App Sandbox , entitlements, Keychain, packaging, and updater pipelines.
  • Practical WebRTC experience; spatial audio; jitter/latency tuning.
  • Android/iOS publishing (fastlane or equivalent), push notifications, and in-app review flows.
  • Docker , CDN , and networking basics for real-time apps.
  • Accessibility (VoiceOver/TalkBack) and internationalization.


Benefits & Environment

  • Remote-first, flexible hours, and competitive market range .
  • Fast feedback loops, ownership, and a product with real impact on how teams work every day.
  • Support for learning, events, and continuous improvement.

description:
Position Overview


We are seeking a Manager of Endpoint Engineers to lead our endpoint management team in maintaining and securing 600+ corporate devices across our global organization. description:
Sobre a Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Data Scientist altamente qualificado(a) e versátil para integrar nossa equipe de analytics avançado. Nesta função, você será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e implementar sistemas de recomendação, modelos de previsão de séries temporais e soluções de machine learning baseadas em algoritmos de boosting e árvores de decisão.   • Colaborar com engenheiros de dados e engenheiros de ML para implantar modelos em ambientes Azure e Databricks.
  • Realizar exploração de dados, engenharia de features e avaliação de modelos.
  • Apresentar descobertas e modelos de forma clara para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre as mais recentes ferramentas e metodologias aplicadas em machine learning.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação ou Mestrado em Ciência de Dados, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência comprovada com sistemas de recomendação e modelos de séries temporais.
  • Sólido conhecimento em algoritmos de boosting e árvores de decisão.
  • Proficiência em Python e bibliotecas como scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, statsmodels.
  • Experiência com serviços em nuvem Azure e Databricks.
  • Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e habilidade para trabalhar de forma independente.
  • Inglês fluente (oral e escrito).

"Um mundo onde os produtos essenciais cheguem na sua casa com a mesma facilidade que a água chega na torneira".

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a Full-Stack Data Engineer to join our Mobile Applications department. This is a hybrid role that combines data engineering with data science overlap, giving you full ownership of the data lifecycle — from ingestion to transformation, analysis, and storytelling.

You will build and optimize scalable pipelines, ingest mobile app data from diverse sources, ensure infrastructure reliability, and deliver insights that directly influence how our apps grow. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics, equally capable of writing production-grade pipelines and uncovering meaningful trends in user behavior.


Key Responsibilities


Data Infrastructure & Pipelines

  • Build and maintain scalable, end-to-end pipelines across cloud environments. Ingest and transform data from files, APIs, mobile telemetry (Firebase, Amplitude, Google Analytics), and external databases into centralized stores.
  • Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Implement data quality monitoring, governance policies, and best practices for privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Participate in technical architecture discussions, contributing expertise on scalable, efficient data systems.


Analytics & Insights

  • Conduct exploratory and advanced analysis using SQL, Python, and statistical methods.
  • Collaborate with Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support experimentation and A/B testing by ensuring clean, reliable datasets and analyzing results.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that influence mobile product strategy, user acquisition, and retention.


Collaboration & Best Practices

  • Engage in peer code reviews to uphold high standards of quality and maintainability.
  • Work cross-functionally with software engineering and business teams to ensure data solutions align with company priorities.
  • Document pipelines, workflows, and methodologies to foster reusability and knowledge sharing.


Who You Are


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency in Python (or a similar programming language such as Java or C#).
  • Experience with AWS (Redshift, RDS, S3) and Google Cloud (BigQuery, Firebase) for managing cloud-based databases and analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar).
  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ELT/ETL best practices, and dimensional modeling. Experience with version control systems (e.g., GitHub).
  • Excellent communicator who can bridge technical depth with clear storytelling for non-technical stakeholders.

Professional competence (Job related) 专业能力 （与工作相关）:

  • 3年及以上食品配料或添加剂行业销售经验，有亲水胶体相关从业经验者优先；
  • 熟悉亲水胶体（卡拉胶、琼脂、复配食品添加剂等）产品应用技术，具备与客户针对亲水胶体应用技术方面进行沟通交流；
  • 语言：除本国母语外，要求英语流利，中文沟通者更佳；
  • 良好的书面及口头表达能力，熟练使用常用办公软件。
  • 有较强的商务谈判能力


  • At least 3 years and above sales experiences in food ingredients or food additives industry,working experience in hydrocolloid industry is preferred.
  • Be familiar with the application technology of hydrocolloid, and have the ability to develop project with customer by using carrageenan, agar, konjac gum and blended solutions.

（3）Language: In addition to native language, English fluency is required, Chinese communicator is preferred

（4）Good written and oral communication ability, proficiency with office software.

（5）Good commercial negotiation ability


主要职责：

  • 负责市场开发、客户开发和维护和销售管理等工作。
  • 负责所属区域的产品宣传、推广和销售,完成销售的任务指标。
  • 制定自己的销售计划，并按计划拜访客户和开发新客户。
  • 搜集与寻找客户资料，建立客户档案。
  • 做好销售合同的签订、履行与管理等相关工作，以及协调处理各类市场问题。
  • 具有团队协作精神，有效利用内部、外部资源完成销售目标。


Key Accountabilities

(1) Responsible for market development, customer development maintenance and sales management.

(2) Responsible for product publicity, promotion and sales in the region, and complete the sales target.

(3) Make your own sales plan, visit customers and develop new customers as planned.

(4) Collect and find customer information, and establish customer files.

(5) Well management of sales contract signing, implementation, and with good coordination and deal with various market issues.

(6) Have good teamwork spirit, and effectively use internal and external resources to achieve sales targets.

title: Web Developer
description:

Our client is seeking a skilled Web Developer located anywhere in Latin America to join our team on a part-time basis. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a remote environment and enjoys solving technical challenges.

Salary

$500 USD

title: Analista de PCP Júnior
description:
A Lola vem crescendo e revolucionando o mundo dos cosméticos e para acompanhar este crescimento, estamos com oportunidades para você que é apaixonado(a) por beleza.


Nosso Time de Recursos Humanos está com oportunidades para você que deseja aplicar seus conhecimentos e desenvolver habilidades numa empresa que vem revolucionando o mercado de cosméticos no Brasil e Exterior.


Escolha Lola, Escolha Ser Feliz!

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia ou Administração de Empresas;

  • Vivência com SAP, MRP, ERP e S&OP;


Soft Skills:

Modalidade | Local de Trabalho: Presencial | Taquara - Jacarepaguá | Rio de Janeiro/RJ

  • Seguro de Vida;

  • Descontos em Produtos da Marca;
  • Cesta Básica.

description:

- Capacidade de monitorar a execução de scripts;

- Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis, como Scrum ou Kanban;



Atividades:

- Desenvolver e manter dashboards e relatórios interativos em Power BI;

- Atualizar e garantir a consistência e acurácia dos indicadores de performance (KPIs);

- Realizar modelagem e tratamento de dados utilizando Power Query, Excel Avançado e SQL;

- Executar rotinas de ETL para integração e preparação de dados de diferentes fontes;

- Monitorar a execução de scripts automatizados, garantindo estabilidade e alertando sobre falhas;

- Realizar análises quantitativas e qualitativas com foco em performance e eficiência;

- Gerar insights baseados em dados para apoiar a tomada de decisões estratégicas;

- Garantir a qualidade, padronização e governança dos dados utilizados;

- Contribuir para a criação e manutenção de dicionários de dados e documentação técnica;

- Oferecer suporte técnico aos usuários de relatórios e painéis de performance;

- Conduzir treinamentos e elaborar manuais de uso das ferramentas desenvolvidas;

- Acompanhar a evolução de tecnologias e tendências em BI, automação e dados;

- Sugerir melhorias contínuas nos processos e soluções existentes;

- Atuar de forma colaborativa em equipes multidisciplinares com foco em resultados;

- Zelar pela ética, qualidade e confiabilidade das informações produzidas.



Outras informações:

- Local de trabalho: Botafogo – RJ.

- Escala de trabalho: 5x2 - 2ªf a 5ªf de 8h às 18h/ 6ªf de 8h às 17h.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior DevOps Engineer with 6+ years of DevOps and AWS experience to work with other team members on maintaining and executing organizational policies and procedures for change management, configuration management, release and deployment management, service monitoring, support, and problem management of the client's solutions for internal and customer environments.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2,000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The company's solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit from the automation of the most complex business processes, which reduces operating costs, saves time, and increases profitability through reporting, analytics, and decision support systems that were once exclusive to major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand their infrastructure requirements, design solutions with cost mitigation in mind that meet their needs, and implement transparently and efficiently
  • Manage and optimize AWS environments using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) best practices via tools such as Terraform
  • Own the design, development, and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines - ensure rapid yet reliable code deployments
  • Integrate security practices into the infrastructure development lifecycle, including network security, identity management, and data protection
  • Ensure the achievement of SLOs via the implementation of effective SLIs to monitor systems and aid in issue diagnosis
  • Expand documentation and provide training to ensure clarity and proficient management by others, reducing future onboarding time
  • Monitor and optimize cloud spending
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest cloud computing and DevOps trends and best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 6+ years of experience in architecting, deploying, and managing complex enterprise-grade software solutions using AWS across various delivery modalities - mobile applications, web applications, APIs, web services, and UI frameworks
  • Extensive experience with CI/CD pipeline optimization via IaC platforms, must be highly knowledgeable of Terraform
  • Solid experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes), version control systems (Git), and scripting languages (Python, Bash, and more)
  • Proven site reliability experience achieving SLOs through the definition and implementation of effective SLIs
  • Experience with operational database management in AWS (Aurora MySQL/PostgreSQL)
  • Deep understanding of modern security best practices and a proven track record of implementing secure solutions
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to bridge gaps between technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • A strong aptitude for tackling complex challenges with right-size solutions that mitigate costs while assuring exceptional end-user experiences
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in environments that are constantly evolving and occasionally ambiguous


Desired Experience (not required)

  • University degree in Business, MIS, or Engineering
  • Familiar with New Relic, Loggly, and CloudWatch
  • Skilled in shell scripting (e.g., Bash, Python, and PowerShell)


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoys taking on challenging work, wants to grow their skills, and excels in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment, while building software. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively and efficiently. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Desenvolvedor BigCommerce
description:
Somos uma empresa do Grupo Stefanini. Especializados em marketing digital, utilizamos uma abordagem integrada que combina tecnologia, inteligência de dados, design e profundo conhecimento do comportamento do consumidor. Nosso foco está em potencializar os resultados de nossos parceiros, oferecendo soluções que vão desde consultoria estratégica até a execução e acompanhamento dos projetos. Com um time dedicado e altamente qualificado, a Gauge se destaca por sua capacidade de entender as necessidades específicas de cada cliente e entregar resultados de alta performance.

Com forte presença na América Latina e em expansão nos Estados Unidos, estamos sempre na vanguarda, aplicando as últimas tendências de mercado e mantendo um olhar atento à inovação contínua.


DESENVOLVEDOR BIGCOMMERCE


Resumo da Vaga


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) BigCommerce para atuar no desenvolvimento, customização e manutenção de nossa plataforma de e-commerce B2B/B2C. Este(a) profissional será responsável por implementar novas funcionalidades, integrar sistemas (como ERP, CRM e gateways de pagamento), otimizar performance e garantir a melhor experiência para o usuário.



Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver soluções personalizadas usando Stencil, JavaScript e APIs BigCommerce
  • Criar e manter integrações com sistemas externos (ERP, CRM, gateways de pagamento, antifraude, etc.)
  • Participar da definição de arquitetura e decisões técnicas da plataforma
  • Trabalhar com o time de design para traduzir protótipos em páginas funcionais e responsivas
  • Garantir segurança, performance e escalabilidade da loja online
  • Atuar com metodologias ágeis em ciclos de entrega contínua
  • Monitorar e suportar o ambiente de produção com foco em alta disponibilidade


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada com BigCommerce (Stencil, APIs REST, Webhooks)
  • Domínio de JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3 e Git
  • Experiência com integração de APIs RESTful e arquitetura orientada a serviços (SOA)
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de e-commerce headless
  • Vivência com ambientes de versionamento e homologação


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em frameworks modernos como React ou Vue.js
  • Experiência com ferramentas como Postman, Jira e GitHub.
  • Vivência com plataformas como Salesforce, SAP ou Adyen
  • Conhecimento em personalização de checkout, regras de cupom, clusterização de preços e frete

title: Project Manager
description:
If you are passionate about leading projects end-to-end, aligning teams, and ensuring clients achieve real results, this role is for you. At SMT, our Project Managers are strategic partners who shape outcomes and help clients unlock the full value of the Medallia platform.

What You Will Do

  • Lead implementation projects from discovery and design to testing, training, and go-live.
  • Act as the main point of contact with clients — building trust, managing expectations, and ensuring flawless delivery.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams (analysts, consultants, solution architects, developers, and client stakeholders) to meet milestones and deliverables on time.
  • Define project plans, schedules, and scope while proactively managing risks, issues, and dependencies.
  • Facilitate workshops and design sessions, ensuring clear communication and stakeholder engagement at every stage.
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize delivery, enhance processes, and maximize client value.
  • Monitor progress and provide regular updates to clients, stakeholders, and internal teams.
  • Support and coach project team members, ensuring alignment with goals and high-quality results.


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience as a Project Manager, preferably in SaaS or technology-driven environments.
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong business acumen in project planning and management.
  • Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills to manage complex projects effectively.
  • Exceptional communication skills — equally comfortable with executives and technical teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities with a focus on quality and client success.
  • Fluency in English, Spanish and French


✨ Join us and help transform how organizations understand and act on customer experience.

title: Advogado
description:
Atividades:


  • Elaborar pareceres e orientações jurídicas sobre temas trabalhistas, societários e regulatórios.
  • Prestar assessoria jurídica consultiva interna com análises preventivas e soluções jurídicas estratégicas para mitigação de riscos, assim como auxiliar no desenvolvimento de defesas e estratégias em eventuais autuações administrativas ou processos judiciais.
  • Acompanhar alterações legislativas e regulatórias, avaliando impactos e propondo medidas de adequação.
  • Atuar em auditorias e fiscalizações internas e externas, fornecendo informações jurídicas e documentações necessárias.
  • Interagir com órgãos reguladores e acompanhar processos administrativos, quando necessário.
  • Elaborar e revisar contratos com prestadores de serviço, fornecedores e parceiros, com atenção a cláusulas de responsabilidade ambiental, trabalhista e regulatória
  • Assistir com o cadastro da empresa e demais empresas do grupo Oceaneering perante clientes e pela manutenção e renovação dos cadastros.
  • Representar a empresa nas audiências trabalhistas como preposto e responsável pelo acompanhamento dos processos judiciais e administrativos junto a escritórios externos de advocacia
  • Responsável pela emissão, controle, renovação e revogação das procurações outorgadas pela empresa.
  • Manter contato com os escritórios de advocacia externos responsáveis pelo contencioso da empresa, auxiliando o Diretor Jurídico na condução dos processos e na coordenação do trabalho dos escritórios.



Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Direito com registro ativo na OAB;
  • Possuir experiência prévia em escritório de advocacia ou departamento jurídico;
  • Desejável Pós-Graduação completa em Direito Corporativo, Trabalhista ou afins;
  • Inglês avançado/ fluente.



Local de Trabalho: Centro, Rio de Janeiro/RJ.

title: Gerente de Operações
description:
Descrição:

Gerenciar equipe e supervisionar a realização das atividades da área, elaborando relatórios de controle e monitoramento, prestando assistência aos parceiros comerciais, acompanhando auditorias externas, conduzindo a equipe nos processos de entrega e devolução de quiosques, realizando análise de viabilidade de captação de novos produtos e parceiros, bem como fortalecendo o relacionamento com os operadores, visando garantir a prestação de serviços de qualidade aos clientes.


Atribuições:

  • Promover avaliação periódica da equipe, através da análise dos relatórios de produtividade, prestando feedbacks semanais, a fim de acompanhar o desempenho, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e auxiliar no desenvolvimento dos colaboradores.
  • Prestar assistência aos parceiros Comerciais, coordenando o acompanhamento das faltas e/ou intercorrências de produtos, para monitoramento do cumprimento dos contratos.
  • Acompanhar mensalmente a auditoria externa (Contrato Ambev), presencialmente, prestando informações e auxílio aos auditores, para cumprimento de cláusulas contratuais e conferência do mix obrigatório de produtos nos quiosques.
  • Efetuar fechamento de Auditoria (Contrato Ambev), após a auditoria realizar conferência dos arquivos referentes, a fim de enviar à Ambev e ao setor Financeiro para encerramento do processo e emissão das notas fiscais para pagamento.
  • Acompanhar auditoria diária dos quiosques, através da agenda de visitas dos consultores e reporte do Supervisor, para conferência do cumprimento dos contratos.
  • Elaborar relatórios de controle operacional mensal ou mediante demanda elencando todas as atividades e resultados do departamento, incluindo evidências fotográficas de status dos quiosques se necessário, enviando os dados para acompanhamento pela diretoria.
  • Promover/participar de reuniões com outros departamentos (Atendimento ao Cliente, Manutenção, Auditoria, Postos e Bases, Comercial, Merchandising) conforme agendamento mensal, semanal ou de urgência específica, para alinhamento de andamento de processos, troca de ideias, resolução de problemas e definição de planos de ação.
  • Realizar estudo de viabilidade de novos produtos e/ou parceiros, analisando juntamente com o departamento de atendimento ao cliente, visando trazer maiores resultados aos clientes.
  • Acompanhar relatórios sanitários, conforme reporte da equipe de sanitaristas, para monitoramento das atividades realizadas e do desempenho de cada quiosque.
  • Promover/participar de reuniões com novos operadores, através de agendamento prévio, visando alinhamento de execução do plano de ação inicial operacional onde são dispostas as principais demandas e obrigatoriedades do operador.
  • Garantir cadastro de novos clientes efetuando o processo junto aos operadores via sistema Check List, para obter os dados necessários para firmar novos parceiros e ações.

    • Cultura organizacional baseada em inovação, colaboração e respeito mútuo – profissionais que compartilham desses valores e demonstram paixão por resolver problemas complexos se destacarão no nosso time

title: Online English Teacher
description:
Hello! Estamos selecionando English Teacher para trabalho Online: AULAS PARTICULARES OU EM DUPLAS APENAS


Atenção: Não se candidate caso você não possua licenciatura em Letras Inglês ou esteja cursando.


Diferenciais da Like:


  • Bonus Feriados o teacher recebe (feriados respeitamos a sede do curso _ RIO GRANDE DO SUL - POA)
  • Bonus de 2 semanas pagas (geralmente de 23 de Dezembro á 7 de Janeiro)
  • Treinamentos de 15 em 15 dias pagos.
  • Outros bônus.


Requisitos:


  • Ter disponibilidade para 20 horas para LIkE, preferencialmente NOITES, a partir das 18h00 e tarde a partir do MEIO DIA.
  • Ter energia, dinâmica para ensinar.
  • Ter licenciatura em Letras Inglês completo ou a partir do 4 semestre. Observação: IELTS, TOEFEL, CAMBRIDGE serão um plus, mas não selecionamos quem não tem licenciatura ou está cursando.
  • Inglês nível B2, C1 ou C2, preferencialmente C1 (será aplicada uma prova como parte do processo seletivo)
  • Gostar de adolescentes e adultos (principais públicos).
  • Ter uma boa conexão de internet, um headphone para dar aulas e uma camera com microfone.
  • Saber dar aula de Business English Focus será um essencial.
  • Ter MEI para envio de nota fiscal quando pagamos pelo serviços e para sua aposentaria também. (caso você nao tenha, é fácil de fazer).
  • Conhecimento de GOOGLE DRIVE ( abrir o drive, pastas, compartilhar), GOOGLE CALENDAR (saber abrir um compromisso).


Responsabilidades


  • Das aulas para alunos a partir de 8 anos, adultos, senior.
  • Inglês geral, viagens, negócios e reforço escolar.
  • Apenas seguir o método e planos de aulas.
  • Corrigir os temas e assessments dado aos alunos.
  • Escrever feedbacks mensais sobre os alunos (enviamos a ele)


Etapas da Seleção:


1st - Análise do Currículo.

2nd - Envio de tabela (diary) para você preencher os horários que você tem disponíveis e envio de teste de identidadde/compartamento.

3rd- Entrevista marcada - nesta entrevista iremos conversar um pouco e pedimos a gentileza do teacher mostrar sua didática com uma mini aula de 15 minutos. Tema gramatical e nível enviado por e-mail. E ainda, um teste de conhecimento de DRIVE (abrir o drive, pastas, compartilhar), GOOGLE CALENDAR (saber abrir um compromisso).

4th- Entrevista final, combinações finais e explicações sobre a política do curso, acordos nossos.


Valor aula:

R$32,00 para não formados ( a partir do 4 semestre)

R$ 36,00 a R$ 50,00 para formados (variação é analisado: experiência, exames internacionais, didática)


Forma: Contrato de trabalho. (nao é CLT)

Caso já queira agilizar, envie-nos um e-mail com seus dias e horários disponíveis.


Obrigada.


E_mail:

Observação: Não recebemos cvs por whatsapp, telefonemas e nem por aqui, apenas por e-mail.

title: Software Developer
description:
SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER

REMOTE | LATAM

ROLE:

Property Leads is a fast-growing startup building cutting-edge lead generation and data solutions for the real estate industry. We're a lean, high-impact team of 16, solving complex problems at the intersection of technology, data, and growth.

We’re looking for a Principal Software Engineer to take a lead role in shaping our engineering strategy while staying close to the code. This role is hands-on and high-leverage — ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys deep technical ownership, and wants to directly influence the trajectory of a product and company. 

You’ll work closely with the executive team to scale our technology, grow our team, and help define the next chapter of our platform.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of critical systems with high impact across multiple teams.
  • Drive technical strategy and set engineering standards for scalability, performance, security, and reliability.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, design, and business to influence product direction.
  • Recognize how software and systems engineering drive revenue and reduce costs, and use that lens to prioritize initiatives based on business impact.
  • Hire and mentor senior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, design sessions, and informal coaching.
  • Dive deep into the code, especially in high-stakes systems (think: distributed systems, high-throughput APIs, low-latency pipelines).
  • Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies that can create meaningful leverage.
  • Brainstorm with the executive team on new initiatives from a software perspective.
REQUIREMENTS:
  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 2+ years in a principal role.
  • Proven ability to drive complex technical projects from 0 to production.
  • Deep expertise in the following areas: distributed systems, data platforms, backend APIs, cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong architectural skills and a pragmatic approach to design tradeoffs.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and aligning cross-team stakeholders.
  • Empathetic leadership and the ability to build trust across teams.
  • Proficiency in Python, AWS lambda, MongoDB, ML/AI — but more importantly, fluency in core engineering principles.
  • Highly motivated and detail-oriented with a proven track record navigating a fast-paced environment. 
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
RESULTS:

In your first 6–12 months, success looks like:

  • Reduced errors and downtime to near 0 in production.
  • Led the redesign and major scaling effort of our core lead distribution system, improving performance and reliability.
  • Shipped key infrastructure and product features that unlocked growth and operational efficiency amongst the sales and marketing teams.
  • Established engineering standards across testing, deployment, and code quality.
  • Mentored engineers and helped elevate the overall technical maturity of the team.
  • Played a critical role in hiring and onboarding new technical talent.
  • Introduced tools, workflows, and frameworks that made development faster and more predictable.
  • Built strong partnerships with the executive team and other leaders across the company, helping influence company strategy through a technical lens.
SALARY:
  • Competitive base salary
  • Bonus: Up to 25%, performance-based
BENEFITS:
  • Competitive total compensation
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid Sick Time
  • Flexible work schedule

title: Recruitment Consultant
description:
Company Overview: AMX Healthcare is a leading national workforce solutions provider committed to connecting talented healthcare professionals with exceptional career opportunities. We're driven by innovation, technology, and a supportive, dynamic culture that fosters personal and professional growth.


Role Summary: The Recruiter will be responsible for conducting high-volume candidate outreach via telephone, screening healthcare professionals for both temporary and permanent assignments, effectively selling job opportunities, retrieving essential compliance documentation, and accurately updating our Applicant Tracking System (ATS). The ideal candidate will thrive in a fast-paced environment, be comfortable with high call volumes, and excel at building lasting relationships with healthcare professionals.


High-Volume Candidate Outreach:

  • Conduct 100+ outbound calls per day to prospective healthcare candidates.
  • Screen and qualify candidates effectively, matching their skills and interests to available job opportunities.
  • Clearly communicate job descriptions, assignment details, and benefits to candidates to generate interest.


Relationship Building & Candidate Management:

  • Establish strong relationships with candidates through consistent and professional communication.
  • Proactively follow up with candidates throughout the recruitment process to maintain engagement and commitment.
  • Actively manage and nurture candidate pipelines for future opportunities.


Compliance & Documentation:

  • Obtain and verify job-specific compliance documents, including licenses, credentials, and background check information.
  • Ensure candidates meet all compliance requirements prior to placement.
  • Maintain up-to-date and accurate compliance documentation within the ATS.


Applicant Tracking System (ATS) Management:

  • Accurately enter and update candidate details, communications, and compliance information within the ATS.
  • Regularly audit ATS records to ensure completeness and accuracy.


Performance & Target Achievement:

  • Consistently meet or exceed daily and weekly activity targets for calls, screenings, candidate submissions, and compliance completion.
  • Monitor recruitment metrics and suggest process improvements to enhance productivity and effectiveness.


Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in recruitment, high-volume candidate sourcing, telemarketing, or related roles.
  • Excellent telephone communication skills and confidence handling high call volumes daily.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize effectively.
  • Familiarity with ATS platforms and compliance processes in healthcare recruitment.


Skills & Attributes:

  • Results-driven, motivated, and capable of working independently and collaboratively.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills for engaging with candidates and colleagues.
  • Detail-oriented with strong administrative skills, ensuring accuracy in documentation and data entry.
  • Resilient, adaptable, and comfortable managing a fast-paced recruitment pipeline.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive base salary with an extremely attractive commission scheme.
  • Comprehensive training and ongoing professional development.
  • An energetic, supportive team environment.
  • Opportunities for career growth within AMX Healthcare.
  • All paid trips abroad for top performers

CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios.

title: Learning Innovation Technologist
description:
About Turing


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.


Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at



About the Role:


We are looking for a Learning Innovation Specialist to elevate Turing’s Talent Development programs through AI-driven tools, creative media, and scalable solutions. This role is part builder, part technologist, and part designer. You will rapidly prototype, produce, and deliver high-impact learning experiences — with a strong focus on video, AI tools, and execution at startup speed.

Key Responsibilities


Media Production


  • Produce and edit high-quality learning videos (AI-generated and light manual editing) that meet enterprise polish standards.
  • Create branded assets (e.g., intros/outros, lower thirds, overlays) and visual consistency across learning content.


AI-Enabled Learning Design


  • Prototype and implement AI-powered solutions (chatbots, adaptive modules, content automation, workflows) to scale learning delivery.
  • Leverage no-code and AI tools to build efficient, scalable content systems.


Systems & Templates for Scale


  • Develop reusable templates, frameworks, and media assets to support onboarding, bootcamps, enablement, and more.
  • Partner with Talent Development Partners (TDPs) and PX team to bring content to life with high-quality visuals and creative delivery formats.


Innovation & Experimentation


  • Explore emerging learning tech (AI personalization, gamification, simulations) and recommend which innovations to scale.
  • Stay ahead of trends in learning media and AI; act as an internal champion for innovation.


Must-Have Skills & Experience:


  • Strong hands-on experience with video editing and media production tools (e.g., Descript, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Synthesia, Runway ).
  • Proficiency with AI and no-code tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Zapier, Murf, MidJourney, Runway ).
  • Ability to quickly prototype and transform concepts into polished, learner-ready outputs.
  • Strong visual design sense and attention to detail — you care about the final product.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and operating in a high-speed, startup environment.
  • (Nice to have) Background in L&D or EdTech, with a working knowledge of adult learning principles.


What Success Looks Like:


  • High-quality videos and media assets produced consistently and on time.
  • AI-powered workflows implemented to reduce manual effort and scale delivery.
  • Talent Development programs enhanced with creative, tech-forward experiences that wow internal stakeholders.
  • A test-and-learn approach: solutions rapidly prototyped, iterated, or sunset as needed.


Values:


  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:


  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

Designer Gráfico Sênior Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Designer Gráfico Sênior, com perfil técnico, visão estratégica e autonomia para liderar a execução gráfica institucional de um projeto de reposicionamento de marca.

A atuação será 100% voltada à execução e consistência visual, com foco em materiais impressos e digitais, sob alto volume de entregas e prazos intensos.O profissional atuará dentro de uma squad estruturada de comunicação, formando dupla com outro designer gráfico e sendo responsável por garantir decisões ágeis, interlocução com clientes internos e orientação operacional no pós-lançamento.

O papel exige senioridade real, tanto para assumir a liderança operacional, quanto para evitar microgerenciamento, conduzindo entregas com autonomia, ritmo e consistência.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Liderar a execução gráfica de peças institucionais e promocionais, impressas e digitais.
  • Garantir decisões rápidas e fundamentadas no pós-lançamento da nova marca.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e interlocutor(a) entre as áreas de comunicação, RH, comercial e segurança do trabalho.
  • Coordenar concepção e produção de brindes, embalagens, sinalização, materiais internos e templates digitais.
  • Gerir o processo de aprovação de arte final e acompanhar produção gráfica de mais de 10 mil peças.
  • Organizar e priorizar demandas, buscando proativamente briefings e antecipando soluções para evitar atrasos.
  • Colaborar com redação e planejamento, assegurando coerência entre linguagem visual e institucional.
Aptidões Necessárias
  • Domínio avançado do pacote Adobe (Photoshop, Illustrator e InDesign).
  • Autonomia e organização para lidar com alto volume de entregas e múltiplas frentes simultâneas.
  • Capacidade de justificar decisões visuais e representar a área em interlocuções com gestores e clientes internos.
  • Leitura visual apurada e aderência a guias de identidade definidos.
  • Proatividade para buscar informações e definir prioridades junto à gestão.
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração multidisciplinar, com foco em agilidade e resultado.
Aptidões Desejáveis
  • Conhecimento em Figma, para uso pontual em apresentações e documentos digitais.
  • Vivência com direção de arte (mesmo que não seja o foco principal).
  • Experiência em squads de comunicação ou metodologias ágeis.
Vivências Necessárias
  • Desdobramento de identidades visuais em peças institucionais e promocionais (papelaria, sinalização, apresentações e documentos internos).
  • Trabalho sob ritmo intenso, com múltiplas demandas simultâneas e prazos curtos.
  • Acompanhamento de produção gráfica e gestão de arte-final.
  • Colaboração com times de comunicação, incluindo redação, planejamento e arte-finalização.
  • Atuação em entregas digitais simples, como PDFs e templates para redes sociais.
Vivências Desejáveis
  • Experiência em estúdios de branding com desdobramentos de marca a partir de guias já definidos.
  • Passagem por agências de publicidade com foco em execução institucional.
  • Participação em projetos de reposicionamento ou lançamento de marca, com governança conduzida por lideranças visuais.
Diferenciais do Perfil Sênior
  • Capacidade de liderar operacionalmente e orientar a equipe em um ambiente de alta demanda.
  • Postura autônoma, resolutiva e estratégica, evitando microgerenciamento.
